correctness.rationale: The concept class J_n is all order ideals of Boolean lattice B_n. Static shattering supports are exactly antichains, so VCdim=binomial(n,floor(n/2)); an unchanging sequence of shattered support points proves Ldim≥VCdim. Exhaustive generation by ideal pairs (A,C) of B_{n−1} with C⊆A yields exact Dedekind counts (3,6,20,168,7581). For Ldim upper bound the exact decision-tree recursion R(F,d) iff some query x admits R(F_x,0,d−1) and R(F_x,1,d−1), with pruning only when |F|<2^d, exhaustively excludes depth width+1 for n≤4. For n5 root ranks 0,1,4,5 have smaller branch <1024; only ranks 2 and 3 remain, whose 2008-concept smaller branches respectively fail depth 10 (independent memoized counts 23644 and 6666 states). Thus Ldim=(1,2,3,6,10), entropy floor(log₂|J_n|)=(1,2,4,7,12), first deficit 2 at n5. I independently ran a complete finite recurrence, not a sampled search.
